content:
Smooth stereo high-pass + resonant low-pass (bob) filter module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) with a little envelope.

press aux to show the revision number and global CPU usage

#1 copy filtration_1-4.zop into /Patches
#2 reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 run "Install filtration..."

v1.4 : startup UI bugfix

v1.3 now installed into /media/orac/usermodules/fx , press aux to check the revision number and show (global) CPU usage

v1.2 : best CPU results (on the M) using multi-processing
